cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got Mum's surprise organized. You keep her in the kitchen while I hide the cake, and I'll give you the signal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell her this was your plan. I got blamed for the last surprise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. My plan, my responsibility. Ask her for the pastry lesson; I'll work round whatever time she gives you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake an entire pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll peel the apples tonight. You choose when to end the lesson, and I'll call that the signal. Can I count on you for the kitchen?

reason: Let A confident signal plan yield to B timing and workload, rebranding B chosen ending as A signal while keeping secret-plan recruitment explicit.
